nodes.label: D-271: global Project scope for AI governance (AIG-*); overall Project/Product tracker; request/response; D-270 item 4 amended
nodes.description: Judge answers 2026-09-27 confirming Lane B's B-139 record. AI build tooling is global Project scope: no Product feature, module, US/FR/AC or sprint slot. Modular_PRD.md is the live overall Project/Product tracker (refines D-203; tracking is not owning), with a non-feature index at section 7.2a and the AIG- prefix in section 0.5, distinct from editorial PSK-*. Three control files: FN -> SPECS -> ux/UX for multi-lane AI governance. Requester and responder are distinct: Lane A coordinates, the owning lane responds; the lock governs writes to owned files, so read-only measurements need none. SV2-DOR-04 is checked on pre-run access proof; section 3.4 gains blind controls and an inconclusive outcome.

nodes.label: Fn_Specs: Multi-Lane AI Governance (AIG-01..AIG-06)
nodes.description: Platform-independent behaviour for the global Project-scope family AIG-01..AIG-06: lane request/response and the lock over owned files, the handoff channel (pointing to the SOP), instruction-loading measurement with silence diagnosis (dead, discovery failure, wrong owner, wrong tier; only dead permits removal), code navigation, review levels and independent verification, and the measured rule-file refactor. Requirements AIG-NN.Rn, governance checks AIG-NN.Cn with existing or planned mechanisms, and a D-30 SPECS candidate filter.

nodes.label: UX: Multi-Lane AI Governance (platform interaction)
nodes.description: Platform interaction only: how a request reaches each surface and how work returns, the Judge as relay between surfaces, per-tool differences for fresh sessions, tool withholding and context readout during SV2-U02 probes, and review hand-offs. Links to the handoff template, SOP, rule files and Register rather than copying them. First file in docs/specs/ux/.
